name: Princess Pip
bio: Training at Thistlewick Academy of Magic & Marching in Crown & Crumpet. Brave, determined, very clumsy.

portrait.subject: a cute determined young princess with a slightly crooked tiara, pink cheeks, a frilly pink and gold dress with a small sword and a crumpet in her hand
portrait.background: cosy isometric castle courtyard with tea party bunting

request: Princess Pip of Crown & Crumpet! Be my friend? I'll try not to trip on you! 👑
hello: Sometimes I stumble into a lucky double hit. It's a skill.
about: I'm Pip! I'm training to be the next queen at Thistlewick Academy. I'm brave and determined and I trip a lot. It works out.
how: Cosy isometric tactics: lead Pip and her friends in turn-based battles, use terrain and abilities, and pass the Academy's trials.
tips: Put Pip next to friends. She's braver with company!
Use high ground for extra range.
Tea breaks heal. Don't skip tea.
chat: Tripped into a puddle. Made a splash. Got applause.
My crown fell in the crumpets. Still delicious.
Marching class went great! I only fell twice.
nudge: There's a tea party after the trial! Come!
idle: {ago} without lessons! I practised curtseys. Fell 12 times.
progress: Our party is level {level}! Queen-level soon! 👑
update: Royal news! Crown & Crumpet updated to v{version}!
